row.notes: cmp dword [rsp+0x40],0 in the watchdog thread loop Ne_Watchdog_ThreadLoop (0x1443e0b80), the first instruction after cmp r14d,r15d; jbe 0x1443e0f9d at 0x1443e0df3, reached only when the time since the last tick (r14d, ms) exceeds the max delay (r15d). Runs once per 1000 ms wake while frames are stopped. Registers and stack match the jbe-taken state at 0x1443e0f9d, so rip = 0x1443e0f9d skips the kill decision for that wake as the game does when the delay has not run out. Reads r14 only.

verify.notes: V8608 disasm: cmp [rsp+0x40],0 (5 bytes) right after cmp r14d,r15d; jbe 0x1443e0f9d, only fallthrough reaches it, no branch targets 0xdfa-0xdfd. Jump 0xdf9 -> 0xf9d safe: no push/pop since prologue so rsp equal; rdi/rsi/r12/r13/[rsp+0x40..0x4c] untouched between the jbe and 0xdf9; ebp is still the boost reason as the jbe-taken path (the defib path reloads it at 0x1443e0f99); flags are dead at f9d (test ebp,ebp); no lock held and no state written before the kill calls. Caveat: the site is also reached with the shutdown flag set (dil!=0, KillInShutdown), so a hook that only reads r14 also holds a shutdown kill; fix adds a dil check.
